questions: Which three groups did the Holy Prophet's (PBUH) social reforms mainly uplift?
His groundbreaking reforms uplifted women, orphans and slaves.
In pre-Islamic Arabia, what cruel practice was done to some newborn girls?
Women were deprived of basic rights and some newborn girls were buried alive.
According to Qur'an 49:13, the noblest person in Allah's sight is the one who is:
'The noblest of you in Allah's sight is the one best in piety, righteousness and reverence.'
Which right did Islam give women regarding property?
The Qur'an (An-Nisa 4:7) gave women a share of inheritance.
What did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) say was necessary for a valid marriage?
Women could not be forced into marriage; her consent was a necessary condition.
He encouraged both men and women to seek knowledge: it is obligatory upon every Muslim.
the act of being freed from restrictions, especially slavery
Emancipation is the act of being freed from restrictions, especially from slavery.
men hold primary power and dominate
A patriarchal social system is one where men hold primary power.
In 'My Beloved Pakistan', the poet compares the flag to:
'Your flag of green and star so white, shines like a beacon in the night.'
Which part of Pakistan is described as having snowy peaks?
'From snowy peaks of mighty North, to deserts glowing in the South.'
What is described as glowing in the South?
The poem speaks of 'deserts glowing in the South'.
What does the poet encourage young people to do for Pakistan?
'We'll work, we'll learn, we'll stand' — the poem inspires unity, learning and service.
The main theme of 'My Beloved Pakistan' is:
patriotism and love for the country
The poem celebrates the beauty and spirit of Pakistan and expresses deep love for the land.
a light serving as a signal
A beacon is a light or visible object serving as a signal.
fly or rise high in the air
To soar is to fly or rise high in the air.
Newly coined words like 'hashtag' and 'unfriend' are called:
Neologisms are newly coined words, many born on the internet and social media.
What does the abbreviation 'DM' stand for?
a bridge language between speakers of different native languages
English is a global lingua franca: a bridge language between speakers of different tongues.
Mixing English with one's native language in online spaces is called:
Mixing languages in conversation is called code-switching.
'Taglish' is a hybrid of English and:
Why have abbreviations like 'LOL' become popular?
Need for speed and efficiency in communication
These terms were born out of the need for speed and efficiency.
Digital globalisation has led to a more ___ approach to grammar in texting and tweeting.
Texting and tweeting have created a more relaxed approach to sentence structure and punctuation.
reduce greenhouse gas emissions and protect the environment
Climate action means efforts to reduce greenhouse gases, adapt and protect the environment.
Burning fossil fuels for energy releases which gas?
The burning of fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide.
The rise in Earth's average temperature caused by greenhouse gases trapping heat is called:
Greenhouse gases trap heat, raising the average temperature: global warming.
Since when have human activities especially disrupted the balance of gases?
Especially since the Industrial Revolution, human activities have disrupted this balance.
In which year was the Paris Agreement signed?
The most notable agreement, the Paris Agreement, was signed in 2015.
Under the Paris Agreement, countries try to keep warming below:
They committed to limit warming well below 2 C, aiming for below 1.5 C.
Who is disproportionately affected by climate change?
Climate change hits poor and developing countries hardest, though they contribute least.
Glaciers melting at alarming rates lead to rising sea levels.
'The Happy Prince' is by Oscar Wilde.
What were the Happy Prince's eyes made of?
For eyes he had two bright sapphires.
What glowed on the Happy Prince's sword-hilt?
A large red ruby glowed on his sword-hilt.
Where had the Swallow's friends gone?
His friends had gone away to Egypt six weeks before.
Why did drops of water fall on the Swallow though there were no clouds?
The eyes of the Happy Prince were filled with tears.
In which palace did the Prince live when he was alive, where sorrow was not allowed?
He lived in the Palace of Sans-Souci, where sorrow was not allowed to enter.
What did the Happy Prince give to the poor seamstress?
The Swallow gently picked out the great ruby and took it to the seamstress.
Why was the little match-girl crying?
Her matches fell in the gutter and were spoiled
Her matches fell in the gutter and her father would beat her.
What did not melt in the furnace?
The workmen said the broken lead heart would not melt in the furnace.
Where were the lead heart and the dead Swallow thrown?
The lead heart was thrown on the dust-heap where the dead Swallow was also lying.
the harmful or wrong use of drugs
taking medicine on a doctor's advice
Drug abuse is the harmful or wrong use of drugs that damages health, behaviour and life.
Which of these is mentioned as a reason people start using drugs?
People try drugs out of curiosity or due to peer pressure.
Which organisation in Pakistan works to stop drug smuggling?
The Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF) works to stop the smuggling of illegal drugs.
Which group is especially at risk of drug abuse, according to the lesson?
Many drug users are young people; teenagers and students are especially at risk.
How does drug abuse affect society?
It leads to crimes, accidents and violence
Drug abuse leads to crimes, accidents and violence, creating fear and insecurity.
Taking sleeping pills or painkillers without a doctor's advice is:
The lesson includes pills and painkillers taken without a doctor's advice as drug abuse.
Which body parts can drugs damage, according to the lesson?
Drugs can damage the brain, heart, lungs, liver and other parts of the body.
the presence of harmful substances in our environment
Pollution is the presence of harmful substances that damage air, water and land.
How do trees help reduce pollution?
They absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen
Trees absorb carbon dioxide, release oxygen, trap dust and reduce heat.
Which of these pollutes rivers, according to the lesson?
Plastics and chemicals dumped in rivers
Plastics and chemicals dumped in rivers pollute the water.
What has contributed to the rise in pollution in Pakistan?
Rapid urbanisation and industrial growth have contributed to the rise in pollution.
Many factories add to pollution because they do not follow proper:
Many factories do not follow proper waste management rules.
According to the lesson, parks and green belts in cities serve as:
peaceful places to relax and exercise
They beautify the surroundings and serve as peaceful places to relax and exercise.
'The Road Not Taken' is by Robert Frost.
Where did the two roads diverge?
'Two roads diverged in a yellow wood.'
Why did the speaker choose the second road?
It was grassy and wanted wear
He took the other, 'because it was grassy and wanted wear'.
Which road did the speaker finally take?
'I took the one less traveled by, and that has made all the difference.'
The central theme of the poem is:
choices and their consequences in life
The poem explores how choices shape our futures in ways we may not understand at the time.
'I doubted if I should ever come back' means the speaker:
felt he might never return to try the other road
Knowing 'how way leads on to way', he felt he might never come back to try the first road.
Diverged means split or branched off.
'The Three Questions' is by Leo Tolstoy.
What did the king promise to anyone who answered his questions?
He proclaimed that he would give a great reward to anyone who taught him the answers.
Why did the king give the reward to none of the learned men?
All the answers being different, the king did not agree with any and gave the reward to none.
Whom did the king finally consult?
A hermit renowned for his wisdom
He decided to consult a hermit widely renowned for his wisdom.
Why did the king put on simple clothes to visit the hermit?
The hermit received none but common folk
He was hiding from enemies only
The hermit received none but common folk, so the king dressed simply.
What was the hermit doing when the king arrived?
Digging the ground in front of his hut
When the king approached, the hermit was digging the ground in front of his hut.
According to the hermit, the most important time is:
Now is the most important time because it is the only time when we have any power.
According to the hermit, the most necessary person is:
the one with whom you are
The most necessary person is the one with whom you are.
According to the hermit, the most important affair is:
to do good to the person you are with
The most important affair is to do him good, for that alone man was sent into this life.
